questions.question: What does evaluating one policy on many episodes fail to measure?
options: Its mean return on those sampled episodes
Sensitivity to training randomness across independently fitted policies
Variation in returns between the sampled episodes
questions.explanation: More evaluation episodes estimate one policy more precisely. To study training variability, repeat training with different seeds and preserve those runs as separate units.
optionFeedback: Repeated episodes can estimate the return of this fitted policy. They do not measure variation across independently trained policies.
More evaluation episodes estimate one policy more precisely. To study training variability, repeat training with different seeds and preserve those runs as separate units.
Episode variation is exactly what those repeated evaluations observe. Add separate training seeds to measure training variability.
